messages:
marta: quick heads-up: PR #4510 preview shows broken redirect targets and missing fonts. preview: https://deploy-preview-4510--docs.redwood.com

lee: hm. which preview provider is this on? we recently rotated preview creds for vercel.

marta: this one is Vercel. build log snippet:
```
00:03:12 Fetching _redirects
00:03:13 WARN failed to fetch private asset: 403 forbidden
00:03:14 WARN skipping asset sync
00:03:15 Site built, draft published
```

infra-bot: infra change: PREVIEW_KEY renamed to PREVIEW_DEPLOY_TOKEN on 2026-01-12. Ensure pipelines use the new env var.

sam: easy fix in the docs workflow. but we should avoid blocking every docs PR while infra rotates secrets. proposal: add a "preview-fast" CI job that only runs mkdocs build and publishes a non-production draft (no private asset fetch). allows content review to proceed.

olivia: agree. also add a tiny PR checklist bullet: "run local serve if preview shows missing fonts/redirects". copy for PR description:
```
# Local quick checks
pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
mkdocs build
python3 -m http.server 9002 --directory site
# or mkdocs serve --dev-addr=127.0.0.1:8000 for live reload
```

lee: for safety, add an automerge guard that requires a `preview-clean` status from CI (only set by the full preview job) before auto-merge. fast preview can pass for content review but won't flip preview-clean.

marta: i'll open two PRs: 1) workflow change to read PREVIEW_DEPLOY_TOKEN and add preview-fast; 2) PR template update + automerge guard action. tagging @sam @lee for review.

sam: small nit: make preview-fast use a different cache key (PREVIEW_CACHE_KEY: $GITHUB_SHA) to avoid stale artifacts.

infra-bot: Vercel deployment queued for PR #4510. Draft URL will post on completion.

olivia: perfect. i'll hold merge on #4510 until either full preview is green or preview-clean check exists. will update here when workflows land. :white_check_mark:
